Anderson]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' *[[Rebecca Moesta]] |cover artist=[[Dave Dorman]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Berkley Boulevard|Boulevard]] |early release= |release date=[[August]] [[1998]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=210 |isbn=9780425164167 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]] |series=''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' |preceded by=[[Young Jedi Knights: Return to Ord Mantell|''Return to Ord Mantell'']] |followed by=[[Young Jedi Knights: Crisis at Crystal Reef|''Crisis at Crystal Reef'']] }} '''''Young Jedi Knights: Trouble on Cloud City''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] young-adult novel written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]]. It is the thirteenth book in the ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' series, and it was first published by [[Berkley Boulevard]] in [[August]] [[1998]]. It also includes a seven-page preview of the next book in the series, [[Young Jedi Knights: Crisis at Crystal Reef|''Crisis at Crystal Reef'']], and a fourteen-page preview of [[Lucasfilm]]'s ''Alien Chronicles: The Golden One''. The novel was reprinted in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Under Black Sun]]'' ([[1999]]).
